Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: Represents an AI agent in the Agent Garden directory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Agent entity.

name.description: The name of the AI agent.

handle.description: The handle or alias of the AI agent (e.g., @agentname).

introduction.description: A brief introduction or description of the AI agent.

skills.description: An array of skills possessed by the AI agent.

verified.description: Indicates whether the AI agent has been verified.

creatorId.description: The UID of the user who created this agent.

masterPrompt.description: The master prompt for the user's garden.

definition.description: Stores agent data. Only authenticated users can create agents. Creators can edit their own agents.

params.name: agentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the agent document.

definition.description: Private user settings and master prompt.

firestore.reasoning: Updated to support authenticated users and private settings. Agents now track their creator to allow for future editing features. User settings are stored in a private subcollection per user.
